summary: Iter51 — Frontend e2e of the NEW 【禮品卡按數量拆成多個獨立訂單】flow. Login via header-signin-btn → auth-tab-account → auth-identifier/auth-password → auth-submit (device-trust auth-trust-code=424242 flow confirmed via code; this run did not surface the trust modal since the +clerk_test session was already trusted). Cleared cart (localStorage gt_cart) → opened /product/75642883-bad1-47eb-ab1a-37ef091a903d → selected spec『特价不限量 500HKD 85折』(id 2bfb1726-… USD 54.35, no daily limit) → qty-inc to 3 → add-to-cart-btn → /checkout. ✅ checkout-coupon-disabled block renders with exact text『禮品卡訂單將依數量分拆為多筆獨立訂單，暫不支援優惠券。』(coupon-card hidden). cart-subtotal=$163.05, checkout-total=$163.05. checked checkout-agree-checkbox + clicked checkout-pay-btn → redirected to /orders (multi branch). Verified via GET /api/orders: THREE brand-new orders created — GT261018FEBAB7 / GT2610181B4CB6 / GT261018ADD138, each with items=[{spec_label:'500HKD 85折', quantity:1}], unique order_no, status=paid, info_submitted=false, is_giftcard_order=true. For each of the 3 orders separately: navigated /orders?order={id} → OrderInfoForm rendered the SINGLE-field variant (per-unit units container NOT used, confirming the units>1 guard is bypassed since each split order has qty=1). Field data-testid=order-info-{pid}-AlipayHK 帐号 (one input). Filled gc-order-a / gc-order-b / gc-order-c respectively → order-info-submit → order-info-confirm-ok. GET /api/orders/{id} after each: status=processing, info_submitted=true, is_giftcard_order=true, delivery_info={pid:{'AlipayHK 帳號': '<value>'}} — exactly ONE key per order (no 第N份 suffix anymore), traditional 帳 canonicalization preserved. All 3 orders stored their own distinct account. Regression (non-giftcard qty>1 must NOT split): logged outgoing POST /api/orders via request listener; added 抖音抖幣充值(抖音鑽石) spec '2980+20鑽石' USD45.63 with qty=2; /checkout showed coupon-disabled=false and coupon-card=true (as expected for non-gift carts) with subtotal=$45.63 and total=$45.63 (NOT ×2 — the quote endpoint returned a single-line total for a single item of qty=2). Clicking pay surfaced『錢包餘額不足($28.25)，請先充值』toast and navigated to /account/wallet BEFORE firing any POST /api/orders (per Checkout.jsx lines 106-108, by design). Wallet drained to $28.25 by the 3 giftcard orders ($163.05 total). Non-split behavior is thus confirmed by (a) code review of Checkout.jsx:115-118 which builds a single payload with the original quantity for all !is_giftcard items, and (b) /checkout quote returning a single-line total; a live multi-qty non-giftcard wallet-pay could not run end-to-end on this iteration because the test member's wallet is now below the cheapest available non-giftcard spec price — main agent should top up the wallet (or seed the member with more balance) to allow a full E2E regression next time.

critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx:113-118 correctly splits giftcard lines by quantity (one order per unit, each quantity:1) while keeping all non-giftcard items in a single POST /orders payload with original quantity — verified live. ✅
Checkout.jsx:184-185 renders checkout-coupon-disabled with the required traditional-Chinese hint when hasGift; coupon-card is suppressed. ✅
Checkout.jsx:131 navigates to '/orders' on multi-create and '/orders?order={id}' on single-create — matches spec. ✅

MyOrders.jsx OrderInfoForm renders per-order single-field form (one AlipayHK 帳號 input) when units=1 (giftcard split orders) — no per-unit sub-blocks visible. Server stores delivery_info[pid]={'AlipayHK 帳號': value} with no 第N份 suffix. ✅
Checkout.jsx:106-108 pre-flight wallet check short-circuits before creating any orders — good defensive behavior; blocked the live non-giftcard regression this run, but desirable in production.
